description: pthread_barrier over the native Dunit futex (M6-E pthread subset, M6.5 audit fix). The barrier owner's wait used a raw Linux SYS_futex (ENOSYS sentinel) and busy-spun; now it blocks on the native FutexWait via __futexwait like every other musl wait path (toolchains/dunit-musl/src/thread/pthread_barrier_wait.c). userspace/ctests/musl_barrier.c rendezvouses 4 threads at a barrier. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_barrier_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 240 --boot-timeout 120

required.claim: all 4 threads reached and crossed the barrier (no deadlock on the native futex) and exactly one got PTHREAD_BARRIER_SERIAL_THREAD
pthread_barrier works over the native Dunit futex

forbidden.why: barrier init/create failed or threads did not rendezvous correctly
